Mutant Feature - Insect Wings.name: Mutant Feature - Insect Wings
Mutant Feature - Insect Wings.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Insect Wings
Two pairs of clear, veined insect wings set between the shoulder blades.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Insect Wings.traitNarrativeEffects:
Visual selection only: a permanent Mutant feature of the body; keep it consistent in every portrait, even when the Quirk Type is Emitter or Transformation. It adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; the Quirk traits decide what it can do. Two selected features for the same body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the one whose name comes first alphabetically. If Quirkless or No Quirk was chosen, there is no heteromorph body: do not draw this feature.

Portrait: two pairs of long, narrow insect wings grow from between the shoulder blades through openings in the clothing. At rest they lie flat, angled back, the tips reaching the backs of the thighs. Thin and transparent, crossed by a fine network of dark brown-black veins, with a faint rainbow sheen where light strikes; they stay clear whatever the hair or skin color. Keep them at rest unless the selected pose spreads them.
